study: Systems study of Alien Hominid (Flash, 2002, The Behemoth) — mechanics and genre research only. All assets original. Nothing from the source game is copied.
engine: Godot 4.7 GDScript, phone-first optional (this game is landscape 960x540 design, stretch canvas_items/expand), gl_compatibility

laws.constants_not_magic: every movement/combat number is a named const in scripts/feel.gd (LLM-verb-modulatable)
laws.growing_battery: each subsystem lands with its own test suite; nothing is done until its suite passes twice consecutively
laws.headless_replays: verify-retry drives the real scene tree with scripted InputEvent replays (walk-right-and-shoot run; do-nothing run for soft-locks)

signature_systems.enemy_ride: Down+Jump above an enemy mounts it; mount flails blinded; friendly fire hits the mount; bite scares nearby enemies; flip-and-throw
signature_systems.burrow: hold Down on ground: invulnerable, can drag enemies under, suffocation timer 4.0s kills the player; uncovers occasional extra life

scoring.style_bonus: riding/throwing/burrowing variety adds style points; every 5000 style = +1 life

art_direction: chunky hand-drawn cartoon 2D, bold outlines, flat colors; v1 static sprites + programmatic squash/stretch tweens (frame-by-frame animation budgeted later)
